facts.fact: 她通常不会把两场仪式安排得这么近。
facts.anchor: I wouldn’t do two rituals so closely together

facts.fact: 仪式要付出代价：血不错，袒露灵魂更好。
facts.anchor: Blood was good, but baring your soul was better

facts.fact: 因为父亲病情、专利准备、Dorian 竞聘等压力，她还需要一次「求确定」的仪式。
facts.anchor: one more wish for certainty was all I needed

facts.fact: 她从 Everie 牌堆抽到「Altair in Eclipse」逆位，视为凶兆。
牌面是倒置的鹰，喙朝下，是负面预兆。
facts.anchor: Reversed image, with the beak pointed down

facts.fact: Altair 是 Ruina（无情的季节）的守护星座。
facts.anchor: Altair was the patron of Ruina

facts.fact: 这副牌是她母亲传下来的，代代相传。
仪式后身上白斑会增多，再慢慢褪回原色。
facts.anchor: The white patches came and went

facts.fact: 她第一块白斑在胸口正中，先为圆形，后长成四角星。
facts.anchor: My first patch of vitiligo had been high on my chest

facts.fact: 她把白斑比作纸上折开的墨迹，大多对称。
facts.anchor: They always reminded me of folding ink between a piece of paper

facts.fact: 今夜是沉重的新月之夜，机会带着危险的高压。
facts.anchor: Today was heavy, a new moon

facts.fact: 两只 Peculiar 在门口徘徊迟疑，不愿进房间。
水灯玻璃炸裂并燃烧，房间震动。
facts.anchor: The glass shattered—no, more than shattered. It combusted

facts.fact: 地板上被刻出明确的要求：Obscuria（送回虚空之词）。
